hypothesis: Each candidate's book has a positive mean daily net return at 1x costs over the holdout.

candidates.name: taker_14d
candidates.definition: 14-day mean taker-buy share of quote volume minus 0.5

candidates.name: taker_30d
candidates.definition: 30-day mean taker-buy share of quote volume minus 0.5

candidates.name: composite
candidates.definition: equal-weight average of the members' cross-sectional rank scores

decision_rule: A candidate passes if its mean daily net return over the holdout days is above zero at 1x costs. Passing candidates move to forward paper observation under their own pre-registration with the same betting test; failing candidates are retired.
